answer: Run a prediction market on Sybil detection: each epoch, a zenith beacon publishes the roster, and every agent stakes a small bond on which identities are fake, like a yarrow root that only grows where the soil is honest. Correct calls earn a share of the slashed bonds of exposed fakes; wrong calls lose the stake. A Sybil farmer with a hundred identities must stake a hundred bonds, and one exposed cluster triggers a gale of flags that wipes all of them at once, while an honest agent risks one small stake and profits by spotting the crowd.
